Independently rebuilt each coordinate graph, enumerated ALL 65,536 labelled spin assignments each and reproduced every sector B,C entry for r=0..8 (and complement symmetry for 9..16), including Shrikhande C6=32 vs rook C6=1224. Convex envelopes of sector points give exact field breaks 1,3,6 vs 2,6 and all coexisting labelled degeneracies. Finite exhaustive census is a complete proof of finite multiplicities because the entire 2^16 domain is visited, not sample extrapolation.
